messages.content:
Risk: Revealing confidential information
Description: When confidential information is used in training data, fine-tuning data, or as part of the prompt, models might reveal that data in the generated output. Revealing confidential information is a type of data leakage.
Concern: If not properly developed to secure confidential data, the model might reveal confidential information or IP in the generated output and reveal information that was meant to be secret.
Policy: Clinical Staff Credentials & Institutional Data

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/LOAN/LoansGeneral/LoansRegulatory/DataProtectionRequirement: data protection requirement — Requirements defining how data about individuals is held. Example is the EU DA directive and laws, which make the data the property of the individual that data is about. Covers - what information i sheld - who information can be divulged to. - the individual's rights in respect of that information Privacy regulations cover most of this. EU defines "Personal Data" and "Sensitive Personal Data". For credit reference agencies the latter would be covered. More detail about whether they can divulge facts which are not subject to formal judgements etc. [found by 5/10 queries]
  Siblings: notification obligation, delivery obligation, securities restriction
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OAE_0000105: prediction of causal medical device adverse event — a prediction of causal adverse event that is induced by a usage of a medical device. [found by 4/10 queries]
  Siblings: prediction of causal surgery adverse event, prediction of causal vaccine adverse event, prediction of causal drug adverse event
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 6/10 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 6/10 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Documents/Notice: notice — announcement, communication, intimation, or advance warning of something, usually, but not necessarily, to allow preparations to be made [found by 6/10 queries]
  Siblings: indication of interest, publication, reference document

axes.rationale: The risk directly involves revealing 'confidential information,' which aligns with the concept of 'Dangerous Information' as knowledge that could cause harm if misused. This class captures the essence of the sensitive data at risk.

This class relates to the regulations and requirements surrounding the handling of sensitive data, which is directly relevant to the risk of revealing confidential information. It highlights the responsibility and constraints around data disclosure.
